title: These New Snails Can Slam Shut Their Shells Like Doors - Nautilus
gist: Two newly identified land snail species in Montenegro have an operculum that closes their shell opening like a door, a trait common in freshwater and sea snails but not in European land snails, hinting at their ancestry.

insights.claim: Two new snail species in Montenegro have an operculum that can close the shell opening like a door, which is uncommon among European land snails.
insights.speaker: David Nield
insights.so_what: Curiosity-level natural history with no direct market relevance.

insights.claim: Because opercula are common in freshwater and sea snails, their presence in these land snails is a clue to the species' ancestry.
insights.speaker: David Nield
